profile.Civilian Name: Ryan Lim; Lin Wei Jie (林伟杰)
profile.Civilian Appearance: A fit young man with slightly messy black hair, dark-brown eyes, and a relaxed smile. His usual clothing consists of T-shirts, shorts, and comfortable shoes. He has a friendly, approachable appearance and rarely looks particularly serious outside work.
profile.Guardian Appearance: Current wears a dark-blue and turquoise Guardian uniform with flowing wave patterns. His outfit includes lightweight fabric resembling moving water, and silver details inspired by ocean currents. His hair takes on a deep-blue sheen, while his eyes become bright turquoise.
profile.Signature Ability: Tidal Flow — Current manipulates the direction, pressure, and speed of moving water. He can redirect dangerous currents, create powerful streams for offensive attacks, and generate controlled water routes to assist rescue operations. His abilities are particularly effective in coastal environments and waterways.
profile.Strengths: Water manipulation, mobility, maritime rescue, offensive pressure, adaptability, teamwork, quick reactions, and remaining calm during unexpected situations.
profile.Weaknesses: Large-scale water manipulation consumes significant energy, particularly when he must generate water rather than control an existing source. His relaxed attitude can cause him to underestimate danger, and his impulsiveness occasionally leads him to act before planning.
profile.Fear: Being unable to reach someone struggling in water before it is too late.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Mangrove, Luma Skyline, Luma Beacon
profile.Loves: The ocean, swimming, freedom, and spending time with friends.
profile.Likes: Water sports, travelling, seafood, joking around, and trying new activities.
profile.Dislikes: Strict routines, unnecessary restrictions, excessive paperwork, and overly complicated plans.
profile.Hates: People deliberately endangering others or refusing to help during emergencies.
profile.Hobbies: Swimming, kayaking, diving, gaming, and exploring beaches.
profile.Personality: Current is cheerful, adventurous, and easygoing. He enjoys teasing his teammates, particularly Skyline, whose serious personality contrasts strongly with his own. Although he sometimes appears carefree or irresponsible, Current becomes surprisingly focused during dangerous situations. He is deeply protective of people in distress and rarely hesitates to jump into action when someone needs help.
Personality Example: When Skyline spends several minutes explaining an evacuation route, Current jokingly asks whether swimming there would be faster.
During a mission involving a capsized boat, Current immediately becomes serious and concentrates entirely on rescuing the passengers.
After being scolded by Mangrove for taking unnecessary risks, he agrees to be more careful, only to make another ridiculous suggestion several minutes later.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Current becomes unusually quiet and sleepy when feverish. His normal enthusiasm disappears, and he loses interest in teasing others or participating in activities. He becomes surprisingly obedient, occasionally asking his teammates to help with simple tasks because he lacks the energy to do them himself.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Current becomes extremely energetic, affectionate, and sociable when intoxicated. He enthusiastically declares that everyone is his best friend, initiates ridiculous competitions, and repeatedly challenges Skyline to games. His impulsiveness becomes significantly worse, occasionally requiring Mangrove to physically stop him from attempting something dangerous.
profile.Core Idea of character: A free-spirited Guardian who learns that protecting others sometimes means resisting the current rather than following it.
Quotes: "The sea doesn't wait for anyone. Neither can we."
"If someone's drowning, I'm not standing here discussing it."
profile.Background:
Ryan grew up near Singapore's coastline and developed a love for swimming and marine activities during childhood.
After awakening as a Water Guardian, he discovered that his magic naturally specialised in controlling currents and water pressure rather than creating conventional water constructs.
His civilian experience in marine engineering further strengthened his understanding of waterways, vessels, and maritime safety.
After becoming Full-Fledged, Current joined Five-Foot Way, where his abilities proved especially valuable during coastal rescue missions. He later became one of the four members of Horizons.
